messages:
sam (recruiter): heads up 60; several interviewers reported 403s opening interview kits (PDFs + scorecard attachments) this morning. seen on candidate C-5012 and C-5020.

maria (people-ops): uh oh. any error ids or timeline? blocking panels today?

sam (recruiter): got an error from an interviewer: "GET https://files.redwood.com/kit/C-5012.pdf -> 403 (signed url expired)" Panels at 10:30 and 11:00.

jess (eng): checking logs. calendar-bot: did we deploy the token-ttl change last night?

calendar-bot: deployment token-config-v2 applied at 2026-06-09T03:12:04Z (service=files-signer, change=token_ttl:24h->4h)

jess (eng): yep that change shortened signed URL TTL from 24h to 4h. some kits were generated yesterday afternoon so URLs are expired. my bad for not coordinating with ops.

maria (people-ops): can we reissue links en masse for affected panels? we have 6 interviewers across two loops that need immediate access.

jess (eng): yes. plan: 1) roll back TTL to 24h to stop new links from expiring mid-cycle, 2) run backfill to reissue signed urls for any kit created in the last 48h, 3) add alert when >1% of file requests return 403. will pause the config rollout now.

oliver (trainer): for short-term mitigation can I paste fallback links to the panel chat? non-technical interviewers might need a single-click. also, does this affect training certification artifacts?

jess (eng): fallback links are the same signed urls once reissued. training cert attachments are stored in same bucket, so they'll be fixed by the backfill.

sam (recruiter): also noticed some interviewers had the kit link blank (not just expired) 60; might be a separate bug where front-end caches empty pointer.

jess (eng): good catch. i'll include a step to flush cache keys for candidate kits in the backfill job.

maria (people-ops): please pause any automated kit pre-generation until the rollout is coordinated with People Ops. adding a checklist item: "confirm files-signer TTL with People Ops before production change" to post-deploy runbook.

jess (eng): rolled back TTL to 24h and kicked off backfill for kits created in last 48h (job id: backfill-kits-2712345700). ETA ~8m. also created alert rule and PR for change docs.

calendar-bot: job backfill-kits-2712345700 started at 2026-06-09T09:22:00Z, affected_kits=18

jess (eng): backfill finished 60; reissued links and flushed cache. tested with sam 60; interviewers can open kits now. PR: https://github.com/redwood/files-signer/pull/215 (adds runbook step + alert).

sam (recruiter): verified with interviewers 60; all good. thanks for the quick turnaround.

maria (people-ops): great. scheduling a 10m sync to update runbooks and coordinate future infra changes that touch candidate-facing assets.

oliver (trainer): i'll also add a note to interviewer onboarding: "if a kit 403s, ping People Ops before rescheduling".

jess (eng): sorry for the disruption 60; will loop in product and infra next time. closing incident ticket REC-5722 after we add the runbook entry.

sam (recruiter): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
